column1: How a data change is requested
Every change to a data product follows these steps.

column3: The requester raises the change with the business owner, with the reason and the date it is needed
The data steward assesses the effect on the read mapping, the checks, the reports and the models; the ACE team assesses it too where a Tier 1 or Tier 2 field moves
The business owner approves. Compliance approves where personal data changes; Risk where a limit or a model input changes
A Tier 1 or Tier 2 change is made by the ACE team, through RWB-ACE-001 for a new field; a Tier 3 or Tier 4 change goes to the Workbench backlog; a list or limit change is a validated load
The change runs through the ACE ingestion checks and the view conformance test in SIT
In the monthly release, or as a validated reference load with a valid from date
The data dictionary and the mapping are updated with the version
